RIGHT: two different groups of volunteer participants, original group in charcoal and new group with teal clothing, both connected to identical assessment sheets and a magnifying glass; communicate testing the same question with newly collected data, without showing a guaranteed identical result or a success checkmark. Clean sophisticated hand-drawn ink outlines and sparse muted teal and red accents, white space, friendly adults diverse in age and appearance, readable from the back of a room. All important objects inside central 80% of the canvas. Avoid text, logos, equations, decorative floating shapes, 3D effects, and medical diagnostic details. Two scenes horizontally aligned at identical visual scale. This is conceptual artwork, not a data visualization.
